scope: Read-only primary source recovery for P09, P19–P22, P27 and V07. New source copies and reports only.
source_change_summary: Official PFArena code and gated dataset entry point recovered, replacing the earlier unknown-link blocker. Other inspected tasks remain blocked on exact source protocols/artifacts.
preserved_scope_notes: P09 remains a valid prediction setting; learned protein representations may matter.
P27 is not replaced by P26.
P19–P22 are source-only recovery: no mutation input rows, objective-specific generation or candidate ranking was executed.
V07 remains a pipeline component setting; generic sample rows and alternate datasets are not benchmark evidence.
No protected test outcome was used for source choice, prompt selection, parser tuning or model selection.

verified_facts.claim: NatureLM Section 7.2 and Table 20 explicitly report binary stability classification, not continuous regression.

The current publisher main branch has two inference notebooks, README/configuration/lock files and administrative files, with no processed stability test or label conversion implementation. Both notebooks were inspected as JSON code cells without execution.
The cited SFM-Protein paper Section 4.3 reports stability regression with Spearman; that citation does not recover the NatureLM binary endpoint.

blockers: Exact NatureLM binary labels, conversion threshold/rule and processed case manifest are absent from the recovered publisher artifacts.
PEER/TAPE continuous stability P08 cannot establish the missing binary conversion.
tasks.resolution: Obtain the NatureLM-author processed binary test and conversion implementation, then reconcile all IDs and labels before freezing a native scorer and source-preserving Qwen adaptation.
tasks.good_score_establishes: Agreement with the specified binary stability endpoint once recovered, under the disclosed model and training regime.
tasks.bad_score_establishes: Poor agreement under that endpoint and input regime; it would not isolate verbal reasoning or prove absence of protein representations.

blockers: Frozen temporal case IDs, annotation snapshots/cutoff and executable ROUGE reference preprocessing are unrecovered.
tasks.resolution: Obtain the author temporal manifest, original sequences/references, cutoff and scorer settings. Mol-Instructions P26 and arbitrary contemporary NCBI rows cannot be called this holdout.

tasks.bad_score_establishes: Limited reference-text overlap under the supplied sequence-only regime; alternative accurate annotations can also have low overlap.

verified_facts.claim: Ryze Section 3.3/Table 3 compares OCR conditions on three components. It does not state component test case IDs/counts, answer-model checkpoint, prompt, split selection or executable accuracy normalization.
The pinned public BenchmarkRunner creates a synthetic sample benchmark when a requested JSON file does not exist; those placeholder rows are not any of the three component tests.
The inspected main OCR processor renders PDF pages and calls Tesseract with --psm 6. It does not implement the full named GLM-OCR/chart/cross-reference/cleansing condition from Table 3.

Generic evaluation code computes BLEU/ROUGE/exact-match metrics, with no named loader or source split manifest for these component tests. The second public branch retains identical benchmark.py, metrics.py and ocr.py blobs.

upstream_public_candidates.name: ArXivQA scientific-figure collection (candidate identity, not confirmed Ryze component slice)
upstream_public_candidates.qualification: This name also identifies unrelated text-only collections; Ryze does not provide an identifier resolving the ambiguity.

upstream_public_candidates.name: SlideVQA original author repository
upstream_public_candidates.qualification: Original upstream source exists; the Ryze split/subset, page context and extraction configuration are unverified.

upstream_public_candidates.qualification: Original human/augmented source tests exist; Ryze does not specify their selection/weighting or answer normalization.

blockers: Exact Ryze component IDs/splits, original media mapping and human/augmented aggregation are not recovered.
The extraction implementation/configuration and downstream answer model/prompt/scorer required to reproduce Table 3 are unrecovered.
tasks.resolution: Obtain the author component manifest and Table 3 execution recipe. Direct Qwen image QA could be a different declared baseline, but cannot complete this extraction-component setting or reproduce the Ryze pipeline by renaming it.
tasks.good_score_establishes: Answer-relevant information preservation and downstream QA performance of the declared extraction/answer pipeline on the recovered slices.
tasks.bad_score_establishes: A failure somewhere in extraction, evidence selection or answer generation under that pipeline; it would not isolate protein reasoning or identify a single failure stage without an authorized separate experiment.
